parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "call",
  "params": {
    "service": "object",
    "method": "execute_kw",
    "args": [
      "odoo_crm",
      2,
      "YOUR_ODOO_PASSWORD",
      "crm.lead",
      "create",
      [{
        "name": "Telegram Lead - {{ $('Telegram Trigger').item.json.message.chat.id }}",
        "contact_name": "{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.lead.name }}",
        "phone": "{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.lead.phone }}",
        "email_from": "{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.lead.email }}",
        "partner_name": "{{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.lead.company }}",
        "description": "Product interest: {{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.lead.product_interest }}\nRequirement: {{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.lead.requirement }}\nBudget: {{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.lead.budget }}\nTimeline: {{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.lead.timeline }}\nLocation: {{ $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.lead.location }}",
        "source_id": false
      }]
    ]
  },
  "id": 2
}
